extracted.name: Chilled Strawberry Soup
extracted.description: Frozen strawberries pureed with milk, cream, and sour cream are sweetened with sugar and chilled overnight to make this sensational summer soup.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons white sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Puree strawberries, milk, cream, and sour cream in a blender or food processor until smooth. Stir in sugar to taste. Chill 8 hours or overnight in refrigerator before serving.
